mapper.sql: O_CODE,GRADE_ORG_ID, GRADE_DATE,O_TYPE, SHORT_LONG_TERM,GRADE_RESULT, CREATE_USER,CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME, DATA_SOURCE,SOURCE, STATUS, ERR_MSG
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING a USING ( SELECT #{oCode} O_CODE, #{gradeOrgId} GRADE_ORG_ID, #{gradeDate} GRADE_DATE, #{oType} O_TYPE, #{shortLongTerm} SHORT_LONG_TERM, #{gradeResult} GRADE_RESULT, #{dataSource} DATA_SOURCE, #{source} SOURCE, #{status} STATUS, NVL(#{errMsg},'') ERR_MSG, #{createUser} CREATE_USER, #{createDept} CREATE_DEPT, #{createTime} CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser} UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime} UPDATE_TIME FROM DUAL ) b ON (a.O_CODE = b.O_CODE AND a.GRADE_ORG_ID = b.GRADE_ORG_ID AND a.GRADE_DATE = b.GRADE_DATE AND a.O_TYPE = b.O_TYPE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.SHORT_LONG_TERM = b.SHORT_LONG_TERM, a.GRADE_RESULT = b.GRADE_RESULT, a.SOURCE = b.SOURCE, a.STATUS = b.STATUS, a.ERR_MSG = b.ERR_MSG, a.UPDATE_USER = b.UPDATE_USER, a.UPDATE_TIME = b.UPDATE_TIME WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( O_CODE,GRADE_ORG_ID, GRADE_DATE,O_TYPE,SHORT_LONG_TERM,GRADE_RESULT,DATA_SOURCE,SOURCE,STATUS,ERR_MSG, CREATE_USER,CREATE_DEPT,CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (b.O_CODE,b.GRADE_ORG_ID,b.GRADE_DATE,b.O_TYPE,b.SHORT_LONG_TERM,b.GRADE_RESULT,b.DATA_SOURCE,b.SOURCE,b.STATUS,b.ERR_MSG, b.CREATE_USER,b.CREATE_DEPT,b.CREATE_TIME,b.UPDATE_USER,b.UPDATE_TIME)

AND (ASSET_CODE like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR ASSET_NAME like '%' || #{search} || '%')

and STATUS in ('A','E')
